notes.title: Medium-Sized Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Update Highlights:[/b]
This update brings significant changes to the [b]Tavern Assessment System[/b], enhances staff and items, and refreshes UI/music.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]📜 Detailed Patch Notes:[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]New Dynamic Challenge System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tavern assessments now apply [b]1 random restriction[/b] (e.g., limited staff/tables).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Guild Interface Overhaul[/b][/p][list][*][p]Completely redesigned [b]Guild UI[/b] for better clarity.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Soundtrack[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]exclusive BGM[/b] during assessments.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Rebalanced Guild Bond Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]Effect: Permanently boosts a recipe’s price by [b]100/200/400 gold[/b] (tier-based).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Item Rarity Adjustment[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Sailor’s Brown Ale[/i] downgraded to [b]Common[/b] (new price: [b]400g[/b]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Merchant Skill Rework[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]"Today’s Special"[/i]: Now reduces [b]refresh cost & selling price by 60%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Harvest Day Buff[/b][/p][list][*][p]Perfect dish chance ▲ from [b]10% → 30%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Premium Drink Adjustment[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Misty Way Pale[/i] price ▲ [b]+500g[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Hire Bonus (Carpenter Apprentice)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Immediately grants [b]1 Hardwood Long Table[/b] upon recruitment.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Minor updates & bug fixes
notes.content:
[p][b]This update focuses on further refining the demo experience. Here are the changes:[/b][/p][p][/p][olist][*][p][b]Guild privileges[/b] and [b]Yellow Scorpion sanctions[/b] can now be temporarily suspended, allowing players to review other information before making decisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Notifications in the [b]top-right corner[/b] are now clickable and will redirect to their relevant pages.[/p][/*][*][p]Employee profiles now [b]correctly display[/b] explanations for each attribute’s effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Stamped Wine List[/b] could generate empty orders.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kitchen sabotage sanctions[/b] will now automatically force the second chef to take a break.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flooded Cellar[/b] has been [i]properly fixed[/i] (no more surprises!).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug preventing [b]special employee mission[/b] from being completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect [b]popularity display[/b] after kitchen sabotage.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]special ingredient purchases[/b] to correct quantity errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where reaching [b]100 Affection points[/b] wouldn’t trigger its intended effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched an exploit allowing [b]unrestricted waiter recruitment[/b] after the first hire.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Balance Adjustments:[/b]
    12. [b]Apostle of Lamo’s Skill III[/b] bonus reduced from 5% → 2%.
    13. [b]Veteran Bartender’s[/b] multiplier decreased from 3× → 2×.
    14. Lowered the base price of [b]Downfall aristocrat’s Aged Wine[/b].
    15. [b]Ice Sky Spoon[/b] upgraded to [i]fancy-tier[/i], while [b]Bar Water Jug[/b] is now [i]normal-tier[/i].
    16. Adjusted the [b]Dragon Arena butcher[/b]’s starting menu.
    17. [b]Master Craft’s[/b] bonus increased from 0.1% → 0.3%.[/p]

notes.title: Small Update & Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]**Thank you so much for all the feedback you've provided over the past two days!** I’ll address these issues as quickly as possible to improve the gaming experience. [/p][p][/p][p]For now, I’ll focus on fixing bugs and more critical problems. Once the game stabilizes, I’ll start working on larger content adjustments to make it even more fun! [/p][p][/p][p]### **Here are the changes in this update:** [/p][p][/p][p]1. Flooding the cellar will now automatically reduce the number of barrels to a maximum of 3. [/p][p]2. Manually removing barrels now prioritizes empty ones first. [/p][p]3. Fixed a discrepancy between the required bribe amount and the displayed text for Masked. [/p][p]4. Fixed a mismatch between the repayment amount and the dialogue text for Baiying Teacher. [/p][p]5. Removed the "Refresh Tasks" feature. [/p][p]6. Fixed an issue where dismissed employees still appeared in dialogues. [/p][p]7. Fixed an issue where dismissed employees’ equipment was not unequipped. [/p][p]8. Fixed an issue where gift-giving didn’t complete the intended task. [/p][p]9. Advanced employee training tasks now accept **either "Liked" or "Loved" gifts** (previously only "Loved"). [/p][p]10. Employees threatened with Yellow Scorpion sanctions will now receive a warning. [/p][p]11. Fixed incorrect display text for "Position Full" reminders. [/p][p]12. Baiying Teacher can no longer be dismissed via employee threats. [/p][p]13. Fixed an issue where pressing the spacebar accidentally advanced to the next day. [/p][p]14. Fixed duplicate employees appearing in the chat interface. [/p][p]15. Fixed an exploit allowing infinite equipment farming from Masked. [/p][p]16. High-tier quests no longer reward Guild Privileges. [/p]
